summary: Frontend-only E2E test (admin sales@dbgsigns.com + salesman sam@dbgsigns.com) of the new margin/actions-menu/bulk-delete/clickable-number features on Estimates, Sales Orders, Invoices, plus DocBuilder margin+commission and Settings low-margin threshold. All 10 requested feature areas verified working EXCEPT one critical regression: after choosing any item in the new ⋮ ActionsMenu, the whole page becomes non-interactive (document.body pointer-events:none) until a manual reload.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL page-freeze: after clicking ANY dropdown item (Web view, Edit, Internal note, Delete, Email, Approve...), document.body keeps pointer-events:none and a stale Radix dialog/popper node stays mounted, so NO further click anywhere on the page works (verified: row checkbox, other ⋮ buttons, header buttons) until the user reloads. Reproduced 4/4 times on Estimates for Web view, Edit(DocBuilder close via Esc AND via Cancel), Internal note and Delete-cancel. Opening the menu and pressing Escape without selecting an item does NOT freeze (pointer-events:auto), which isolates the cause to the item onSelect handler: `onSelect={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); it.onClick?.(); }}` prevents Radix DropdownMenu from closing, so its body pointer-events lock is never released. Suggested fix: remove e.preventDefault() (or defer the action: `onSelect={() => setTimeout(() => it.onClick?.(), 0)}`) so the menu closes and Radix restores body pointer-events.

Selecting a salesman (e.g. 'Sam Salesman (10%)') does not auto-populate 'Commission rate (%)' (stays 0), so the preview reads '$300.00 x 0% = $0.00' while the saved estimate correctly shows $30.00 (10%). Misleading preview; prefill rate from the chosen salesman's commission_rate.

Cosmetic/data: most pre-existing demo rows show Customer = 'Unknown' (customer records were removed by earlier test runs). Not caused by this change set, but the list shows 'Unknown' rather than a graceful placeholder.

integration_issues.issue: Non-reproducible anomaly observed once: after a UI save of 0 the API later returned low_margin_threshold=65 (equal to shop_rate_per_hr). Two subsequent controlled runs (save 30, then save 0) sent correct PUT payloads and persisted correctly, so this could not be reproduced. Worth a quick look at Settings save/state race; left threshold restored to 0 (original value).

issues: Margin values render green (#16A34A) and low-margin flags red (rgb(211,34,34)) with adequate contrast on white; no spacing/alignment problems observed. PDF popup opened by number links renders as a browser PDF viewer tab (expected).

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: ActionsMenu item onSelect e.preventDefault() leaves body pointer-events:none -> whole page unclickable after any row action on Estimates/Sales Orders/Invoices. Let the menu close (drop preventDefault or defer onClick).
Prefill DocBuilder 'Commission rate (%)' from the selected salesman's rate so the commission preview matches the saved value.
Optional: re-verify Settings low-margin threshold save (one-time value drift to 65 observed, not reproducible).
critical_code_review_comments: ActionsMenu.jsx line 22: `onSelect={(e)=>{e.preventDefault(); it.onClick?.();}}` keeps the Radix DropdownMenu open/locked; combined with opening a Dialog from the item this permanently strands the body pointer-events lock. This single line breaks every row action on three pages.

MarginCell/list margin logic is consistent with backend (margin / material selling price); invoice detail per-line margin uses material_margin/material_cost where line 'material_cost' is the SELL amount, which matches - keep field naming consistent to avoid future confusion.

Estimates.jsx/SalesOrders.jsx/Invoices.jsx each duplicate the same GET /settings low_margin_threshold fetch and selection/bulk-delete logic - extract a shared hook (useLowMarginThreshold / useRowSelection) to satisfy DRY.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (9/10 feature areas pass; ActionsMenu post-click page freeze fails)

Invoice number opens the detail dialog. (6) DocBuilder: editable Sell/sqft + Cost/sqft, material select auto-fills both (3.5035 / 0.637), per-line 'Margin 60%', 'Material margin (internal) 60%' summary, live totals; commission block titled 'Sales commission (on gross profit)' with base $300 = 506.66 total - 200 material cost - 4.33 shop - 2.33 machine. (7) Invoice detail dialog shows per-line Margin % and 'Material margin - internal only' 60.0%. AFTER THE ACTIONSMENU FIX: retest each dropdown item end-to-end (Approve->SO, Email, Void, Record payment) since the freeze previously prevented chaining actions in one session.
rca_of_the_issue: Radix DropdownMenu applies pointer-events:none to document.body while open and removes it on close. ActionsMenu.jsx calls e.preventDefault() inside DropdownMenuItem onSelect, which suppresses the automatic close, so the menu's modal lock is never torn down; the visible menu disappears (focus/dialog overlay) but the body lock remains, making the entire page unclickable. Repro: login as admin -> /estimates -> click any ⋮ -> click any item -> try to click a row checkbox (fails; getComputedStyle(document.body).pointerEvents === 'none'); a page reload restores interactivity. Mitigation: remove preventDefault or defer the handler with setTimeout(...,0) so Radix closes and unlocks the body.
